description:
Remote access VPN client for AT&T IP VPN services

The AT&T Global Network Client for Windows allows your PC to easily access your AT&T IP VPN services to your company's corporate network as well as the Internet. It provides a simple, powerful interface that automatically detects and connects over cellular, WiFi, broadband and dial networks, and gives workers a consistent VPN access experience with highly secure remote access to keep communications and data private.
- Update SQLite to version 3.53.2
- Update OPSWAT OESIS to version 4.3.6375
- Remove Wi-Fi database and the Wi-Fi update application from the client
- Address concerns, including all discovered by various scans
- Bug fix: Setting the profile from the command line
- Bug fix: Various minor bugs addressed
